critical_code_review_comments: services/channel_attribution.py — clean separation between pure compute_weights() and side-effectful recompute_and_persist(); lift floor=0.5 prevents zero-weight starvation; cold-start branch correctly handles all-zero case with equal 1/3 split. Tolerates both legacy float dollars (`amount`) and new integer cents (`amount_cents`) on payment_transactions, and both `spend` (dollars) and `spend_cents` on ad_spend rows. Persisted doc keyed by _id=<channel> so upsert is idempotent.

services/theme_suggestions.py — algorithm matches spec exactly: MIN_RECENT_ORDERS=3, MIN_DISTINCT_MAKERS=2, growth_pct≥25%, MAX_TAG_LEN=32, blacklist=handmade/etsy/custom/made-to-order/new/sale, slug regex strips non-alnum. _active_theme_filters() correctly excludes tags already covered by an active theme. The pre-filled draft (50000 pool / 5000 maker cap / 2000 listing cap / tomorrow+7d window) is a safe default.
scheduler.py — cron registered at 04:30 UTC, BEFORE the 04:45 promote_allocator job so the allocator sees fresh weights — correct ordering.

Frontend api.js — all 6 new helpers (adminFetchChannelWeights, adminRecomputeChannelWeights, adminSuggestPromoteThemes, adminFetchPromoteThemes, adminCreatePromoteTheme, adminSetPromoteThemeStatus) use adminAuthHeaders, verified by zero 401s in browser network panel.

PromoteThemesCard data-testid=promote-themes-suggest works.
